snippet.title: Hive Blight - Official Early Access Release Date Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the Early Access Release Date Trailer for Hive Blight, a roguelite strategy auto battler game developed by OptizOnion. Players will assume domain over insect warriors to fight back against the Fungal Threat. Make use of powerful synergies and defeat the Chronomancer in Hive Blight, launching into Early Access on PC (Steam) on March 9.
